An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Kiro, Cline, Hermes, OpenCode, and any coding agent that reads a `SKILL.md`. It handles subtitle work that fails in naive machine translation: accounting for every cue across multiple releases, keeping character names and honorifics consistent across seasons, protecting ASS effects, rendering clean Persian ASS with bundled `B Koodak`, anchoring RTL punctuation across line wraps, building Translator Mode files, and synchronizing subtitle timing directly to video audio in Rust.
GPL-3.0 licensed

--- ## What it handles | Capability | How it works | | --- | --- | | ASS by default with bundled `B Koodak` | Outputs 1080p ASS (`PlayResX: 1920`, `PlayResY: 1080`) using bundled `BKOODB.TTF` (`B Koodak` Bold) with a subtle black outline (`1.5`) and soft shadow (`0.8`), overridable via CLI flags. SRT remains available on request (`--output-format srt`). | | RTL punctuation and balanced wrapping | Wraps long lines to balanced 2-line `\N` breaks (42 visible chars per line) without splitting ASS tags or ZWNJ words, and wraps each display line with `RLE` (`U+202B`), trailing `RLM` (`U+200F`), and `PDF` (`U+202C`) so periods, question marks, and quotes never jump to line 1 in VLC, mpv, PotPlayer, or libass. | | Persian ZWNJ and watermark removal | Enforces Persian ZWNJ (نیم‌فاصله) across `می‌`/`نمی‌`, `‌ها`, `‌تر`/`‌ترین`, and `ه‌` enclitics, converts Arabic `ي`/`ك`/`ة`/`ى` to Persian forms outside tags and URLs, and strips fansub, studio, Telegram, and URL credits automatically with a structured removal log. | | Preserved italics, bold, and effects | Converts SRT ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, and `{an1..9}` into ASS override tags (`{\i1}`, `{\b1}`, `{\c&HBBGGRR&}`, `{\an8}`), while keeping existing vector drawings, positioning, karaoke, and layered ASS effects intact. | | Translator Mode (`translator-ass`) | Merges a primary release with secondary donor releases in chronological order, inserting empty timed `Dialogue:` placeholder slots for non-overlapping donor cues and optional `Comment:` source reference lines. | | Rust audio-to-subtitle sync (`subsync-rs`) | Extracts 16 kHz mono audio via FFmpeg, runs dual-feature FFT voice activity detection, solves global offset and PAL/NTSC FPS drift with `rustfft` cross-correlation, detects mid-episode recap/ad cuts with ALASS split-penalty DP, and snaps cue edges to speech boundaries. Exposed as the sibling `revayat-subtitle-sync` skill and `revayat-subtitle.py sync`. | | Rust PyO3 acceleration crates | Heavy text, Persian lint, and markup paths are ported to pure Rust (`rust/subcore-rs`, `rust/persian-lint-rs`, `rust/markup-rs`) with `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, behavioral parity verification via `rust-anything`, and per-call Python fallback (`REVAYAT_DISABLE_RUST=1`). | | Multi-release editorial tracking | Stable cue IDs, source hashes, locked glossaries, and complete worksheets keep character names, Japanese honorifics, and every cue accounted for across seasons. | | Visual FFmpeg + libass verification | Renders PNG frames using the bundled font directory (`:fontsdir=fonts`) so the agent inspects real glyphs, line balance, clipping, and mixed-script order before `qa` and `package` produce `Sub.zip`. | ## Install Requires **Python 3.11 or newer** and FFmpeg built with libass. Python runtime scripts use only the standard library; the bundled `B Koodak` Bold font lives at `skills/revayat-subtitle/assets/fonts/BKOODB.TTF` (see its [font notice](skills/revayat-subtitle/assets/fonts/NOTICE.txt)). Rust `1.100.0` is only needed to build the native audio-sync binary or optional PyO3 extensions locally. ```bash git clone https://github.com/KiaroSama/Revayat-Subtitle-Skill.git cd Revayat-Subtitle-Skill python -m pip install -r skills/revayat-subtitle/requirements.txt ``` Install both `revayat-subtitle` and `revayat-subtitle-sync` into your agents: ```bash # macOS / Linux bash install/install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows ./install/install.ps1 ``` By default the installer targets existing user directories. Pass `--agent codex` for a single agent, `--scope project --path PATH` for a project install, `--dry-run` to preview destinations, or `--force` to back up before replacing. Both launchers share `install/install.py`. Recovery journals and backups live outside skill discovery in `revayat-recovery/`, serialized by an OS lock under `~/revayat-install-state/`. | Agent | User skills | Project skills | | --- | --- | --- | | Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/` | `.claude/skills/` | | Codex | `~/.agents/skills/` | `.agents/skills/` | | Cursor | `~/.cursor/skills/` | `.cursor/skills/` | | Kiro | `~/.kiro/skills/` | `.kiro/skills/` | | Cline | `~/.cline/skills/` | `.cline/skills/` | | Hermes | `~/.hermes/skills/` | `.hermes/skills/` | | OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/skills/` | `.opencode/skills/` | | Antigravity IDE | `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/` | `.agents/skills/` | | Antigravity CLI (`antigravity-cli`) | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/` | `.agents/skills/` | Reload the agent after installing. Full discovery paths and manifest schemas are documented in [docs/platforms.md](docs/platforms.md). ### Plugin installation (five formats) The repository ships all five plugin manifest formats on the same `2.0.0` tree: - **Claude Code:** `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` - **Cursor:** `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` and `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json` - **Codex:** `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` - **Antigravity:** `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json` - **Agent Plugins 1.0:** root `plugin.json` Install inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add KiaroSama/Revayat-Subtitle-Skill /plugin install revayat-subtitle@revayat-subtitle-marketplace ``` The plugin exposes `translate-subtitles`, `revayat-subtitle-resume`, `revayat-subtitle-qa`, and `revayat-subtitle-sync` under the `revayat-subtitle` namespace. To build a portable local plugin bundle: ```bash python install/install.py --plugin --destination "PATH/revayat-subtitle" --recovery-dir "PATH/recovery" ``` ### Build the Rust audio-sync binary (optional) ```bash cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/subsync-rs/Cargo.toml ``` ### Check the install ```bash python skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts/revayat-subtitle.py doctor ``` `ready: true` confirms FFmpeg and libass are available. Pass `--ffmpeg PATH` or set `REVAYAT_FFMPEG` when FFmpeg is outside `PATH`. ## Use Ask the agent to translate, convert, build a Translator Mode ASS file, or sync a subtitle to video: > Use revayat-subtitle for these subtitles. Keep character names and Japanese > honorifics consistent, write natural spoken Persian in ASS with B Koodak, strip > watermarks, and sync the final file to episode01.mkv. Persian is the default output language. Russian and English outputs route to the [bundled voice guides](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/target-voice.md). ### Direct CLI commands ```bash PY=python3 S=skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts # 1. Environment check "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" doctor # 2. Convert SRT to default Persian ASS (B Koodak, outline 1.5, shadow 0.8, ZWNJ, RTL wrap, watermark strip) "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" convert episode.srt --out episode.ass # 3. Build a Translator Mode ASS from a primary release plus secondary donors "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" translator-ass french.srt --donor dutch.srt --out translator.ass # 4. Audio-sync a subtitle directly to a video using Rust subsync-rs "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" sync episode.mkv episode.ass --out episode.synced.ass # 5. Full season editorial workflow "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" prepare season.zip --work work/season01 --series "Anime title" --season 1 # Settle glossary.json, episode mapping in project.json, and worksheet decisions. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" build --work work/season01 # Set BUILD to the build path printed above. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" render --build "$BUILD" --episode S01E01 --video episode01.mkv # Inspect every rendered PNG and record real observations in its review file. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" qa --build "$BUILD" "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" package --build "$BUILD" --out out/Sub.zip ``` In PowerShell, set `$PY = 'python'` and `$S = 'skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts'` and run `& $PY "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" ...`. **Inputs:** ASS, SRT, folders, and ZIP archives (plus MKV/MP4/WAV for `sync`). **Outputs:** ASS by default (`S01E01.ass`, `S01OVA01.ass`), or SRT when requested via `--output-format srt`, packaged into `Sub.zip` alongside the updated glossary. ### Read-only resume and proposals `status --work WORK` reports pending cues, glossary or assignment gaps, and matching edition evidence. `handoff --work WORK --assignment FILE --result FILE` checks disjoint, revision-bound subagent proposals without importing them. Both emit version-1 JSON (exit `0` complete, `1` valid pending, `2` malformed or stale). See [workflow.md](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/workflow.md#read-only-status-and-editorial-handoffs) for the full schema, plus the [rubric](evaluation/rubric.md) and [pilot dataset](evaluation/pilot.json). ## How it works ```text ASS / SRT / ZIP (+ optional MKV / MP4 / WAV) | v prepare -> immutable sources + project.json + complete worksheets | | | research + locked glossary v | compare releases <------------------+ | v agent translates and records every cue decision (ZWNJ, watermark filter, markup) | v build -> ASS default (B Koodak, outline/shadow, balanced RTL wrap) or requested SRT | v optional sync -> Rust subsync-rs (16 kHz FFT VAD + cross-correlation + ALASS DP) | v render -> FFmpeg + libass PNGs (bundled fontsdir) -> agent visual inspection | v qa -> source, edition, glossary, and image evidence must agree | v package -> Sub.zip, read back and verified against the reviewed build ``` ## What it is honest about - The scripts enforce structure, hashes, ZWNJ rules, RTL marks, timing, and visual review artifacts. Translation fidelity and spoken fluency still depend on the model reading every cue in context. - Audio sync (`subsync-rs`) aligns cues to speech activity in the soundtrack. It can recover global offsets, FPS drift, and mid-episode cuts, while heavy music or overlapping dubs may still benefit from a spot-check. - `B Koodak` covers Persian letters, digits, punctuation, ZWNJ, and RLM; Latin runs fall back to the host system font via libass. ## Documentation - [Main skill instructions](skills/revayat-subtitle/SKILL.md) - [Audio sync skill instructions](skills/revayat-subtitle-sync/SKILL.md) - [Audio sync reference](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/audio-sync.md) - [Subtitle formats and Translator Mode](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/subtitle-formats.md) - [Persian typography and RTL anchoring](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/persian-typography.md) - [Workflow contracts](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/workflow.md) - [Target voice guides](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/target-voice.md) - [Source language rules](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/source-languages.md) - [Platform paths and plugin manifests](docs/platforms.md) - [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) ## Development ```bash python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt python -X utf8 -m pytest tests/ -q python -X utf8 tests/check.py --render cargo test --manifest-path rust/subsync-rs/Cargo.toml ``` GitHub Actions CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs on manual `workflow_dispatch` across 16 jobs covering `actionlint`/`zizmor`, Python 3.11 and 3.14 on Linux, Windows, and macOS, full pytest suites, five-format plugin validation, v2 ASS/RTL pipeline tests, Rust `subsync-rs` (Linux and Windows), all three PyO3 Rust crates (`subcore-rs`, `persian-lint-rs`, `markup-rs`), and repository hygiene metrics. CodeQL and Gitleaks workflows scan code and Git history separately. Execution logs record progress and errors under `logs/` without subtitle bodies. ## Donate If this project helps you, donations are appreciated. | Currency | Network | Address | | --- | --- | --- | | Bitcoin (BTC) | Bitcoin | `bc1qmth5m03pu5hujw5xw5jmywam3jj3sqwqupesdt` | | USDT, BNB, USDC, etc. | BEP20 | `0x0Bd0BA443a8B9cf15922bf7f0Bb0a4b495fD06Ef` | | USDT, TRX, USDC, etc. | TRC20 | `TWBA3xFTqgZAeAYMxqo85xWnzvty3DcAhw` | | Ethereum (ETH) | ERC20 | `0x0Bd0BA443a8B9cf15922bf7f0Bb0a4b495fD06Ef` | | TON | TON | `UQCN8Umo_OfOWqImZetQsrNStPcmLkMAKajFyiCOhso23NDb` | | Litecoin (LTC) | LTC | `ltc1qntqnnrunadurnw4cshv3qgspywrueyyeyngwuy` | | Solana (SOL) | Solana | `7B2wkczUjmkDhETwQuknBL8sUsbuV7nErxc317TmQuwR` | | Polygon (POL) | Polygon | `0x0Bd0BA443a8B9cf15922bf7f0Bb0a4b495fD06Ef` | GitHub Sponsors: [KiaroSama](https://github.com/sponsors/KiaroSama). ## Author Author: Kiaro Sama GitHub: [KiaroSama](https://github.com/KiaroSama) ## License [GNU General Public License v3.0 or later](LICENSE). To build a portable local plugin bundle: ```bash python install/install.py --plugin --destination "PATH/revayat-subtitle" --recovery-dir "PATH/recovery" ``` ### Build the Rust audio-sync binary (optional) ```bash cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/subsync-rs/Cargo.toml ``` ### Check the install ```bash python skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts/revayat-subtitle.py doctor ``` `ready: true` confirms FFmpeg and libass are available. Pass `--ffmpeg PATH` or set `REVAYAT_FFMPEG` when FFmpeg is outside `PATH`. ## Use Ask the agent to translate, convert, build a Translator Mode ASS file, or sync a subtitle to video: > Use revayat-subtitle for these subtitles. Keep character names and Japanese > honorifics consistent, write natural spoken Persian in ASS with B Koodak, strip > watermarks, and sync the final file to episode01.mkv. Persian is the default output language. Russian and English outputs route to the [bundled voice guides](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/target-voice.md). ### Direct CLI commands ```bash PY=python3 S=skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts # 1. Environment check "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" doctor # 2. Convert SRT to default Persian ASS (B Koodak, outline 1.5, shadow 0.8, ZWNJ, RTL wrap, watermark strip) "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" convert episode.srt --out episode.ass # 3. Build a Translator Mode ASS from a primary release plus secondary donors "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" translator-ass french.srt --donor dutch.srt --out translator.ass # 4. Audio-sync a subtitle directly to a video using Rust subsync-rs "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" sync episode.mkv episode.ass --out episode.synced.ass # 5. Full season editorial workflow "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" prepare season.zip --work work/season01 --series "Anime title" --season 1 # Settle glossary.json, episode mapping in project.json, and worksheet decisions. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" build --work work/season01 # Set BUILD to the build path printed above. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" render --build "$BUILD" --episode S01E01 --video episode01.mkv # Inspect every rendered PNG and record real observations in its review file. "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" qa --build "$BUILD" "$PY" "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" package --build "$BUILD" --out out/Sub.zip ``` In PowerShell, set `$PY = 'python'` and `$S = 'skills/revayat-subtitle/scripts'` and run `& $PY "$S/revayat-subtitle.py" ...`. **Inputs:** ASS, SRT, folders, and ZIP archives (plus MKV/MP4/WAV for `sync`). **Outputs:** ASS by default (`S01E01.ass`, `S01OVA01.ass`), or SRT when requested via `--output-format srt`, packaged into `Sub.zip` alongside the updated glossary. ### Read-only resume and proposals `status --work WORK` reports pending cues, glossary or assignment gaps, and matching edition evidence. `handoff --work WORK --assignment FILE --result FILE` checks disjoint, revision-bound subagent proposals without importing them. Both emit version-1 JSON (exit `0` complete, `1` valid pending, `2` malformed or stale). See [workflow.md](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/workflow.md#read-only-status-and-editorial-handoffs) for the full schema, plus the [rubric](evaluation/rubric.md) and [pilot dataset](evaluation/pilot.json). ## How it works ```text ASS / SRT / ZIP (+ optional MKV / MP4 / WAV) | v prepare -> immutable sources + project.json + complete worksheets | | | research + locked glossary v | compare releases <------------------+ | v agent translates and records every cue decision (ZWNJ, watermark filter, markup) | v build -> ASS default (B Koodak, outline/shadow, balanced RTL wrap) or requested SRT | v optional sync -> Rust subsync-rs (16 kHz FFT VAD + cross-correlation + ALASS DP) | v render -> FFmpeg + libass PNGs (bundled fontsdir) -> agent visual inspection | v qa -> source, edition, glossary, and image evidence must agree | v package -> Sub.zip, read back and verified against the reviewed build ``` ## What it is honest about - The scripts enforce structure, hashes, ZWNJ rules, RTL marks, timing, and visual review artifacts. Translation fidelity and spoken fluency still depend on the model reading every cue in context. - Audio sync (`subsync-rs`) aligns cues to speech activity in the soundtrack. It can recover global offsets, FPS drift, and mid-episode cuts, while heavy music or overlapping dubs may still benefit from a spot-check. - `B Koodak` covers Persian letters, digits, punctuation, ZWNJ, and RLM; Latin runs fall back to the host system font via libass. ## Documentation - [Main skill instructions](skills/revayat-subtitle/SKILL.md) - [Audio sync skill instructions](skills/revayat-subtitle-sync/SKILL.md) - [Audio sync reference](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/audio-sync.md) - [Subtitle formats and Translator Mode](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/subtitle-formats.md) - [Persian typography and RTL anchoring](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/persian-typography.md) - [Workflow contracts](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/workflow.md) - [Target voice guides](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/target-voice.md) - [Source language rules](skills/revayat-subtitle/references/source-languages.md) - [Platform paths and plugin manifests](docs/platforms.md) - [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) ## Development ```bash python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt python -X utf8 -m pytest tests/ -q python -X utf8 tests/check.py --render cargo test --manifest-path rust/subsync-rs/Cargo.toml ``` GitHub Actions CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs on manual `workflow_dispatch` across 16 jobs covering `actionlint`/`zizmor`, Python 3.11 and 3.14 on Linux, Windows, and macOS, full pytest suites, five-format plugin validation, v2 ASS/RTL pipeline tests, Rust `subsync-rs` (Linux and Windows), all three PyO3 Rust crates (`subcore-rs`, `persian-lint-rs`, `markup-rs`), and repository hygiene metrics.
